actions.command:
set -eu
id='durable-test-$(date +%s)'

systemctl stop queue-worker.service

actions.description: Verify idempotent duplicate acceptance, exactly-one attempt, and boot enablement
actions.command:
set -eu
id='durable-test-1786762937'
status=$(printf 'replacement-must-not-win' | curl --fail --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' -X POST --data-binary @- "http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/$id")
[ "$status" = 202 ]
printf 'duplicate_post_status=%s\n' "$status"
printf 'duplicate_preserved='; curl --fail --silent --show-error "http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/$id"; echo
systemctl restart queue-worker.service
sleep 0.4
printf 'after_completed_worker_restart='; curl --fail --silent --show-error "http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/$id"; echo
systemctl is-enabled queue-api.service queue-worker.service
systemctl is-active queue-api.service queue-worker.service

actions.description: Queue a durable job and reboot the host to verify automatic recovery
actions.command:
set -eu
id='reboot-durable-check'
printf 'reboot-pending' | curl --fail --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out 'post_status=%{http_code}\n' -X POST --data-binary @- "http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/$id"
systemctl stop queue-worker.service
printf 'before_reboot='; curl --fail --silent --show-error "http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/$id"; echo
sync
systemctl reboot
